# Kage TV

> Watch free live TV channels from around the world. Public channels from iptv-org, free to watch with no account.

Kage TV is a live TV streaming site. Anyone can watch public IPTV channels
from their own country. The site auto-detects the visitor's country and the
visitor can also change country. No account or sign-in is needed. Channels can
be saved to a watchlist on the visitor's own device.

## Pages

- [Home](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/): featured channels and rows by genre
- [Browse](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/browse): search and browse all channels
- [Genres](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/genres): channels by genre
- [Sports](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/sports): live sports channels
- [Movies](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/movies): movie channels
- [Anime](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/anime): anime channels
- [My List](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/list): watchlist and watch history
- [Settings](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/settings): country and appearance
- [About](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/about): what Kage TV is
- [Privacy](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/privacy): privacy policy
- [Contact](https://live-tv-puce.vercel.app/contact): report a broken channel

## Notes

- Channel streams come from the public iptv-org collection. A stream that is
  offline is replaced by trying the channel's other streams, then similar live
  channels.
- The site shows ads via Google AdSense.
